name: South East Technological University
summary: Technological university across Waterford, Carlow and Wexford: about 85 honours degrees via CAO, from Engineering and Law to Nursing and Sport.

ib.text: Six subjects with English (or Irish); Maths only where a course names it. Some ask more: Engineering Maths SL 6 or HL 4; Pharmacy HL 5 in Chemistry and in a second lab science (2026-entry pages).

notes: The same subject is often taught on more than one campus under different CAO codes, so check the campus before you list a code.
Music (SE206) selects by audition; Art (SE207) and the Sports Management and Coaching degrees ask for a portfolio.
